name: louvain
author: f28f69d7
description: Finds communities by Louvain modularity optimization, repeatedly moving nodes and aggregating communities. Use it to discover groups with strong internal connections and report their modularity. Supports directed and undirected graphs; positive edge weights represent connection strength, and unweighted edges count as one. Returns ranked communities with labeled members and registered subgraph IDs, plus the largest community as result_graph_id. A seed makes the heuristic deterministic.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyze.

resolution.description: Positive modularity resolution. Values below 1 favor larger communities; values above 1 favor smaller ones.

seed.description: Random seed for node visit order, making repeated runs deterministic.

top_k.description: Maximum number of largest communities to return, with ties broken by node ID.
